nom: Mixsoon Collagen Glass Skin Hydrating Mask

avis.texte: Not going to buy this again. The product is hood in that it really provides moisture and glass skin appearance but trying to remove the mask is hard work! Does not come off in one piece, flakes alot, it takes time to peel bits and pieces off the face.

Ohh I really like this for my skin. My skin looks so moisturized after I peel the mask. Peeling was a little different than I thought it would be. But I just left it on for 30 minutes. Peeling it was like peeling a sunburn. Bit by bit. It wasn’t horrible to do but takes a bit of time. Maybe I’ll try doing it for the full 50 minutes.
It doesn't peel off easily. It comes off in flakes. Leaves your skin nice and plump, but a chore.

I love this product! It is effective, easy to use, and dries quickly. The quality is great, and it performs exactly as expected. For the price, it is definitely worth the money. I am very satisfied with my purchase and would recommend it to others. I have a pretty clear pink glow afterwards.

avis.titre: Not as advertised, packaging issue turned dangerousNot as advertised, packaging issue turned dangerous
avis.texte: The peel-off film doesn’t come off in one wholesome sheet like it’s supposed to — it tears away in small, uneven chunks, making the whole process messy and frustrating. Instead of leaving skin feeling moisturized and smooth, my skin felt irritated and uncomfortable after the awkward peeling. The scent is also unpleasant, not something I’d expect from a “glass skin” product. What really concerned me: after sitting on my shelf for a while, the product seemed to off-gas or degrade to the point that it melted the plastic bristles of the applicator brush that came with it. That’s not just a quality issue — it raises questions about what’s actually in this formula and whether it’s stable/safe for skin contact over time. Overall, very disappointed. The concept and ingredient list looked promising, but the execution and product integrity fell short in a way that made me question its safety.
Excelente apenas estoy usándolo llevo 2 semanas usándolo, lo coloco una vez por semana, pero me gusta el resultado
Easy to apply and so convenient to take off. It leaves the skin very plumpy and has a very discrete scent.Nice mask to have during winter time.

This mask makes my skin feel so soft and smooth, super hydrating but one thing I have an issue with is the fact that it does not set on my skin, so it does not peel off. I have used multiple times and left on my face for 2-3 hours and it just doesn't set. It more like crumbles off rather than peel, other than that it does a good job. I have very sensitive, eczema prone skin and it doesn't irritate at all. If it peeled then it would get 5 stars

This might actually be the best mask I’ve ever purchased online or in store. The Mixsoon Collagen Glass Skin Mask was simple to apply using the spatula-like application tool. The gel like mask dried very quickly, peeled easily, and left my face feeling smoother, tighter, more hydrated, and brighter. The directions are printed in white on the light pink product - very difficult to read. I was happy to find them in the Amazon product description. This is how to use … Following cleansing and a light basic skincare routine, apply an even layer to your entire face, avoiding the eye and lip areas. Let the active ingredients absorb and the cream to become transparent (about 30 minutes) as it dries. Once the mask is completely dry and transparent film has formed, gently lift and peel it off starting from the edges. Gently wipe away any remaining residue. (Rinse any remaining product with lukewarm water.) *Apply evenly and use a pack brush for better adherence Please note that absorption and drying time may vary based on your skin type and surrounding environment

avis.titre: Contains very little collagen, but lots of excellent peptides
avis.texte: I don't know why this Collagen Glass Skin Mask by Mixsoon is called a collagen mask, because at .0001% concentration it barely has a presence. Never fear though, because the star of the show in this mask is actually peptides, and plenty of them. This mask arrives boxed with a security seal, and inside there is also a foil seal on the tube. The product also includes a silicone spatula thingy for application but I prefer to use my fingers, because it's easier to get it on thicker that way. There is no added fragrance in this product and I did not notice a scent at all. So basically we are meant to spread it around on our face and wait for the mask to dry, which takes about 30 minutes. I could definitely feel it tightening up, and when I moved my mouth and it started detaching, that's when I knew it was time to remove it. I've used this mask twice, and the first time was not as successful as the second time. Mainly because I did not spread it thick enough, so it was a bit tedious to peel off. The second time, after applying a thicker layer, it did come off in one piece. There is something weirdly satisfying about peeling this mask off. Probably because it felt dried down on the surface, but underneath my complexion looked beautifully dewy and well hydrated. My skin felt extremely soft and smooth, so I decided it was a half hour well invested. I'm 64 years old and retired. When I have a special event, I use this mask the night before. It makes my skin feel like velvet! LOVE IT! I took this photo after using the mask.
The Mixsoon Collagen mask is amazing. It leaves my skin super smooth, hydrated, and glowing. Lightweight, easy to use, and gives instant results. I love it! ✨

No me gustó , tenía mucha expectativa por la publicidad, , tienes que poner mucho producto y es difícil de retirar , no es tan hidratante como en la publicidad prefiero la de cosrx es más hidratante y no necesitas poner mucho

From the first time I used it, I noticed visible results. I loved it! My skin feels super hydrated and fresh. It's like a spa at home; it truly transforms self-care. I definitely recommend it to everyone. Ideal if you're looking for a product that's effective and pleasant from the first use.
Leaves my skin looking like glass. I use this every night in my skin care routine

avis.titre: mixsoon Collagen Glass Skin Mask Peel off Facial Packs
avis.texte: I'd never used a face mask like this before, but at 35 I'm always on the search for new products to help with wrinkles and moisturizing. The face mask comes with a silicone spatula that makes it easy to apply without making a mess on your hands or other tools. I probably applied it a bit too thin, because it came off in small pieces like when you peel a bad sunburn. That being said, I immediately felt a difference in my skin after removing it with a towel. My skin felt moisturized and soft and plump! I can't wait to see the difference this makes long-term after multiple uses.

This was my first time using a face mask and I'm not disappointed! The product inside the tube is creamy, i didn't notice a scent. I put it directly on the provided brush and evenly on my face, left it on for about 30 minutes, and peeled! For me, peeling is very satisfying. I didn't put it on thick so the peeling was not one huge pull, some of it was still a little glueish so after peeling what i could i just wiped the rest with a damp rag. My face came out very smooth and stayed that way for hours with no negative reactions.

avis.titre: Mask peel off facial mask that is easy to use and works well.
avis.texte: The mixsoon Collagen Glass Skin Mask Peel off Facial Packs came in a squeeze bottle with a twist off cap and an applicator brush. I actually prefer to use a peel off facial mask since it is less messy compared to clay masks that you have to wash off. The applicator brush was easy to use and it helps with applying an even layer compared to using your fingers. Depending on how thick of a layer you apply, it can take between 30-50 minutes before the mask completely dries for you to peel off. It left my face feeling soft and clean. I did not experience any reaction with my sensitive skin. Made in Korea.

This mask makes the 8th item of this brand I have tried. I love this brand so much. Every single product has worked beautifully on my skin. I am 50 years old and my skin looks youthful, smooth and I get that glass skin look after using this mask. The mask is very easy to apply with the included spatula. You leave it on to dry for 30-50 minutes then peel off. Sometimes not all of my mask peels off so I just use a wet warm cloth to remove the rest. My face is glowing afterwards. I get excellent hydration and so much moisture added to my skin it’s amazing.

avis.titre: fragrance-free with a smooth texture, leaves skin smooth without being greasy
avis.texte: I love this peel-off mask! It has a nice thick texture that is a bit less gel-like than other masks, and has a little more of a cream texture mixed in. I put it on in a thick layer with the included spatula and did notice it took a bit longer to dry than those with a gel-only texture. As it dried, it never felt tight or like it was pulling at my skin. It peeled off pretty well in large pieces, and my skin underneath was so smooth and hydrated! At the same time, it didn't feel greasy or heavily coated, so it really was peel and go. Fragrance-free! Ingredient panel in photos.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin soft and smooth
avis.texte: This mask is a nice little treat for my skin. It comes with a spatula thing to help apply it. It goes on smooth and peels off easily, and leaves my face feeling good afterward. I like that it has collagen and peptides, and it makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. This is a great addition to my skincare routine, definitely an easy way to pamper your face without a lot of fuss.

avis.titre: Boosts Hydration and Barrier Health—Peel-Off Mask with Peptides, Soothing Agents, and Antioxidants
avis.texte: I've been using this Peel Off Mask three times a week for about three weeks. There was definitely some trial and error at the beginning. You have to be careful to apply a very thick layer, otherwise it will peel off in small patchy pieces and you will need to rinse off the leftovers. Even in a really thick layer if you get it around your hairline or eyebrows it's kind of tedious to pick it out of your hair, so I advise that you avoid getting the mask anywhere near there. This mask does feel fairly sticky upon initial application, which is why the included silicone brush is a huge plus to this mask and makes it a great value. I tried applying it with my fingers at first, but I found it difficult to get a thick enough layer to peel off. Then I started using the the brush and now application and removal are very easy. I love what this does to my skin - I apply this after my regular night-time skincare routine which includes a lot of hydration because my skin is combination and very chronically dehydrated. I leave it on for about an hour. When I remove it, my skin is soft, glowing, and deeply hydrated. Getting all that hydration locked in is very important for the health of my skin barrier, so I always follow this with a rich, thick moisturizer. This mask is loaded with fantastic ingredients like humectants (glycerin and hyaluronic acid,) skin soothing ingredients (centella asiatica and sucrose,) moisturizers (ceramide NP and cholesterol,) and antioxidants (Vitamin E and Olea Eur

Mixsoon is a Korean skincare brand well known for their hydrating yet gentle products— this mask lives up to those claims. This product doesn’t have a scent, which is good for sensitive skin. It has a gel like texture but still feels a bit tacky so it can adhere to the skin and form the mask. I have sensitive, acne prone skin, so any small change to my skincare routine usually causes breakouts or dry skin— that didn’t happen after using this. My face didn’t feel dried out or itchy, like it can feel using new products. My skin felt hydrated afterward. With that being said, the mask didn’t come off in one piece for me, like others have also noted in their reviews. I let the mask dry for a little over 30 minutes. Some areas (like the cheeks) came off in bigger pieces, while other areas (i.e. around the nose) came off little by little. This may be a strange comparison, but if you have ever used school glue on your hands, let it dry, then peeled it off, it’s quite similar to how this mask dries, sets, and peels. Pros: - Gentle - Hydrating - Good for sensitive skin - Unscented Drawbacks: - Doesn’t come off as one whole mask Overall, this mask has gentle ingredients with hydrating effects. It doesn’t cause breakouts for my sensitive skin when used on a weekly basis. I will continue to incorporate this product into my skincare regimen.

I have been using this product for about three weeks, and I have noticed some positive effects, including improvements in fine lines, reduced inflammation from acne, and enhanced hydration after each use. I apply the mask twice a week. The standout ingredients in this product are peptides and phyto-PDRN. Peptides are beneficial in skincare because they help increase elasticity and collagen production, and I was impressed to find that this product contains nine different peptides. Similarly, phyto-PDRN is known to boost collagen production, improve elasticity, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. I have personally experienced the effectiveness of both phyto-PDRN and peptides, particularly in reducing inflammatory acne. It is worth mentioning that I felt a slight burning sensation upon application. The mask has a cool feeling when applied and has a tacky texture. While it is easy to peel off, it does not come off in one complete layer. I have attached a photo showing the amount of product I typically use, but since I tend to be heavy-handed, I could certainly use less. Given this, I expect the mask to last a while, and I consider it a great value for the price.

Very nourishing face mask. From application to results, the experience was pleasant, and my skin felt noticeably soft immediately afterward, with hydration that lasted. I can definitely see this becoming a once-a-week or every-other-week part of my routine. I did struggle slightly with the peel-off aspect. After 45 minutes, the mask was difficult to remove in one smooth layer, and it came off quite patchy. I felt like I was missing some spots, so IU ended up rinsing slightly, then patting in the remaining product before letting it dry down and finishing with moisturizer. Next time, I might try applying a thicker layer to get a better peel, but that could use up the product quickly since the tube is fairly small. I also didn’t love the included applicator and found it easier to apply with my fingers. That said, the actual formula is excellent. It's hydrating, soothing, and leaves my skin with a soft glow which was much needed as my face was quite dull before use. A great product, even if the peeling process takes a little trial and error.

avis.titre: Shortcut to Glass Skin - I Love the Effects
avis.texte: As a person who is always looking for the best "glass skin" look I was very intrigued by this. I originally saw it on social media and was very excited to get to try it here on amazon. The product is kind of gooey and it works best when you spread a thick layer of it across your whole face. Although they did provide an applicator, I prefer using my fingers to apply because it gives me more precision. I put it on, leave it for half an hour, and then peel it off. The peeling can take some time, but it is a super satisfying process for me especially when it comes off in big sheets/pieces. My skin softness is greatly improved after using this. Best of all, though, is the glow. I really have that glowy "glass skin" after this, at least for a little while. I am hoping that with consistent use 2-3x a week I can get the effects to stick around. Value for money wise, I think it is reasonable for a mask this quality. It includes phyto-PDRN, hyaluronic acid, and a peptide blend, so you're getting a lot of skin benefits (elasticity, hydration, softness, etc) in one mask.

I was excited to try this mask because I absolutely love the overnight collagen mask I've been using by another brand (Starts with. a M and rhymes with rube, iykyk!!). This one is not explicitly an overnight mask as the instructions say to leave it on for 30 min/however long it takes to dry depending on how thick a layer you put. I applied it too close to bedtime and decided to just go to sleep and wear it overnight. It definitely starts to curl up on its own a bit more and way sooner than the other brands mask, so it seems like it would be best left on for 30 min/used for a shorter treatment. I love these types of masks because they help lock in all the other products I use underneath and make them more effective. My skin seems to love it and after I peel it off, it's bouncy and hydrated. This mask definitely comes off in pieces, but it's gentle and whatever is left can be washed off. All in all, I'd recommend this! Plus it comes with such a nice applicator!!

This peel off face mask is full of good ingredients including peptides, collagen and rose water. It comes nicely packaged and includes an applicator for even application without wasting product on your fingers. It applied with a glue like texture and virtually no scent. It does take a while to dry (instructions indicate 30-50 minutes, and I left on for about 50) and then it peels right off as long as you use a generous amount. I found this mask easier to peel off in 1-2 pieces than other peel off masks I use, and I appreciate that. My favorite thing about this mask is that after peeling it left a thin layer of the product to pat into my skin, which absorbed quickly upon mask removal and left that true glass skin look. Korean beauty products are generally my favorite and this one was fantastic! I look forward to continuing to use it! I’ve added a picture that includes the ingredients.

This mask was easy to use, leaving my skin smoother with noticeably smaller pores. I love that it comes with an applicator to get an even layer. It has no added fragrance and no smell at all, which I appreciate. The product appears milky when it comes out of the tube, but goes on to the skin clear, and quickly begins to dry to a super-shiny "glass" finish. I left it on for 50 minutes. I didn't apply it thickly enough to get a really satisfying peel when I was ready to remove it. I used a damp washcloth to gently remove the mask, which worked fine. Overall, I'm very happy with this collagen mask. It worked really well to make my skin feel smoother.
